operations.command: . /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && ! NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=wrongpass NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password --user-account-only > /tmp/e2e-wrong.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'not the current account password' /tmp/e2e-wrong.log && accepts testpass123 && printf wrong-rejected || { diag; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && if NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD="$(printf 'bad\npassword')" nixosctl change-password --user-account-only > /tmp/e2e-newline.log 2>&1; then exit 1; fi; grep -F "Passwords must be non-empty and contain no newline characters" /tmp/e2e-newline.log && accepts testpass123 && fileaccepts testpass123 && printf newline-rejected

set -e
. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh
boundary=$(perl -e 'print "A7!z" x 127, "A7!"')
if NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD="${boundary}x" nixosctl change-password --user-account-only > /tmp/e2e-password-limit.log 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
grep -F 'Passwords must not exceed 511 bytes' /tmp/e2e-password-limit.log
accepts testpass123
fileaccepts testpass123
NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD="$boundary" nixosctl change-password --user-account-only > /tmp/e2e-password-boundary.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/e2e-password-boundary.log; exit 1; }
accepts "$boundary"
fileaccepts "$boundary"
printf '%s\0' "$boundary" | unix_chkpwd "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user)" nullok
NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD="$boundary" NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=testpass123 nixosctl change-password --user-account-only > /tmp/e2e-password-boundary-reset.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/e2e-password-boundary-reset.log; exit 1; }
accepts testpass123
fileaccepts testpass123
printf password-byte-boundary-verified

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password --user-account-only > /tmp/e2e-change.log 2>&1 && ! grep -F -e newpass456 -e testpass123 /tmp/e2e-change.log && ! grep -F 'PAM password change failed' /tmp/e2e-change.log && journalctl -b -q --no-pager | grep -F "pam_unix(passwd:chauthtok): password changed for $(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user)" && accepts newpass456 && fileaccepts newpass456 && test "$(stat -c %a /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash)" = 600 && printf account-changed || { diag; exit 1; }
. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && accepts newpass456 && ! accepts testpass123 && nowarning && printf survived-reboot || { diag; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-both.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'already uses the new password' /tmp/e2e-both.log && grep -F 'already matches' /tmp/e2e-both.log && { if cryptsetup isLuks "$root" 2>/dev/null; then grep -F 'LUKS password changed' /tmp/e2e-both.log && printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && ! printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root"; else grep -F 'skipping LUKS' /tmp/e2e-both.log; fi; } && printf converged-both || { diag; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'already uses the new password' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log && grep -F 'already matches' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log && { if cryptsetup isLuks "$root" 2>/dev/null; then grep -F 'LUKS already unlocks' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log; else true; fi; } && printf idempotent || { diag; exit 1; }
u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user) && chown -R "$u":"$u" /etc/nixos && printf chowned-ok || printf chown-failed

u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user); ctxline() { grep -E 'NoNewPrivs|CapBnd|CapEff' /proc/self/status | tr '
' ' '; }; { echo "ROOT: $(ctxline)"; echo "RUNUSER: $(runuser -u "$u" -- sh -c 'grep -E "NoNewPrivs|CapBnd|CapEff" /proc/self/status | tr "
" " "')"; echo "SU: $(su -l "$u" -c 'grep -E "NoNewPrivs|CapBnd|CapEff" /proc/self/status | tr "
" " "')"; runuser -u "$u" -- passwd --help >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "runuser-passwd-help-rc=$?"; su -l "$u" -c 'passwd --help' >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "su-passwd-help-rc=$?"; } > /tmp/e2e-caps.log 2>&1; cat /tmp/e2e-caps.log; printf diag-caps-done

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user) && ! runuser -u "$u" -- env NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=wrongpass NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=neverused nixosctl change-password --user-account-only > /tmp/e2e-unpriv-wrong.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'not the current account password' /tmp/e2e-unpriv-wrong.log && accepts newpass456 && printf unpriv-wrong-rejected || { cat /tmp/e2e-unpriv-wrong.log; diag; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user) && runuser -u "$u" -- env NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=newpass456 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass789 nixosctl change-password --user-account-only > /tmp/e2e-unpriv-change.log 2>&1 && ! grep -F -e newpass789 -e newpass456 /tmp/e2e-unpriv-change.log && accepts newpass789 && fileaccepts newpass789 && printf unpriv-account-changed || { cat /tmp/e2e-unpriv-change.log; diag; exit 1; }

set -e; . /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh; u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user) && if runuser -u "$u" -- sh -c "echo bogus > /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash"; then exit 1; fi; test "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash)" = 0:0:600 && test -z "$(find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'nixosctl-password.*' -print -quit)" && printf hash-protected
. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && accepts newpass789 && fileaccepts newpass789 && findmnt -rn --target /var/lib/nixos | grep -F '[/@var]' && printf final-password-persisted

set -e; . /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh; old=/.snapshots/@root/generation-2/etc/shadow; test -s "$old"; HASH=$(awk -F: -v user="$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user)" '$1 == user {print $2}' "$old"); export HASH; if test "$(printf %s newpass789 | crypt)" = "$HASH"; then echo "rollback fixture must contain an older password"; exit 1; fi; sed -i 's/\.mode = "[^"]*"/.mode = "restore-penultimate"/g' /etc/nixos/config/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/default.nix; nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot; printf rollback-prepared

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && accepts newpass789 && fileaccepts newpass789 && ! accepts newpass456 && printf "%s\0" newpass789 | unix_chkpwd "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-user)" nullok && printf password-survived-root-rollback
